Kilnmoor Reborn

KILNMOOR—Only five years ago, the Kilnmoor district was largely dependent on the metal industry. The only accommodation option to stay was the Kilnmoor Rest, a plain roadhouse that served the long-distance van drivers through the region. Today, nevertheless, the district has become a busy center for tourism.

For those who want an economical night, the Slate Barn is the best choice. Standing beside the bus interchange, it provides simple, clean rooms at the most affordable prices in the city.

Travelers seeking for superior-quality lodgings should consider the Beacon Rooms, which opened three months ago. Based in the central part of the district, this mid-range hotel is aimed at business guests and at families. It features spacious rooms and meeting facilities.

The Old Kiln House offers visitors a distinctly different experience. Situated among the antique shops and craft galleries that line Foundry Street, the hotel occupies a restored eighteenth-century manager’s house. Despite having the highest rates in the city, it remains the preferred choice for guests seeking a romantic atmosphere.
